name: Stones
justification: Clean greedy-ordering observation, tiny implementation, single unambiguous number.
solution_sketch:
Both operations yield 3 stones, so maximize the operation count. Operation 2 spends only one stone of b while operation 1 spends two, so run operation 2 to exhaustion first.
k2 = min(b, c//2); then k1 = min(a, (b-k2)//2); answer 3*(k1+k2).
